comparison_run.benchmark_key: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 (reasoning low, max_tokens 2500; new tags-judge run 2026-10-08)

reviewer.disclaimer: Проверка выполнена моделью другой семьи (GPT 6.1 Sol), не экспертами.

blinding.method: Both systems extra and missing pairs deduplicated and globally shuffled; review input has no source or disagreement-type columns.
blinding.limitation: The same reviewer previously saw rules-only phase results. Current input is source-blinded, but this is not a fresh reviewer with no prior exposure.

annotation_policy.confirmation: Direct or unambiguous conceptual support; broad dictionary matches are not enough.
annotation_policy.mandatory: Ordinary duties, requirements and unqualified project stack; alternatives and contextual stack are not turned into personal must-haves.
annotation_policy.corrected_reference: One shared union of original silver and every confirmed observed extra pair from either system.
annotation_policy.unsupported_silver: Unsupported original missing labels are flagged but never removed.
annotation_policy.aggregation: micro; exact tag IDs per vacancy; required and desired collapsed to set membership.
annotation_policy.quote_offset_unit: Unicode code points; zero-based; start inclusive and end exclusive.
annotation_policy.scope: All disagreements observed for these two systems on this fixed corpus, not an exhaustive expert annotation of every skill.

metrics.aggregation: micro; exact tag IDs; required and desired combined
